tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Natural-language search over StockCake's catalog. total_results is the total number of matches across the whole catalog, not just this page. refinements lists exact mood/style values for this query with counts (how many current matches carry each); both are exact filters, so a small count means few

tools.name: find_similar_images
tools.description: Find images visually similar to a given StockCake image id (from search_images results). total_results is the number of similar results returned on this page, not a catalog-wide count.

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Fetch one image with full metadata: an inline preview the model can see (unless include_preview is false), real pixel dimensions, AI-generation provenance (prompt, dates, style), license details, and attribution snippets. Also shows the signed-in user's own edited images (ids ≥ 10000000000, as retur

tools.name: get_license_info
tools.description: License and usage terms for all StockCake images (site-wide CC0 / public domain).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The signed-in user's plan, credit balance (free / subscription / purchased), next resets, download quality and output formats. Requires a free StockCake account (the host will prompt to sign in).

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Image and video models available to generate_image / create_video with the credit price of every tier. Free-credit models are flagged; video is priced per second. Requires a free StockCake account (the host will prompt to sign in).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate a new image from a prompt with one of StockCake's AI models (list_models). Charges credits; free credits cover the free models. Waits up to 45 s — a pending result carries a job_id for get_job. Optional reference images guide the composition (plan-capped). Requires a free StockCake account

tools.name: upscale_image
tools.description: Upscale a StockCake image or one of your edited images 2x, 4x or 8x (lossless PNG output). Plan quality caps apply; charges credits otherwise. Waits up to 45 s, then returns a job_id for get_job. Requires a free StockCake account (the host will prompt to sign in).

tools.name: resize_image
tools.description: Change an image's aspect ratio by extending the canvas with AI (GPT Image 2.5) — the subject is kept, new area is generated. Charges credits. Output is the model's native size — about 1.5 megapixels, up to 1536 px on the long edge — whatever the source size; the result reports exact dimensions. For

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Generate a short video from a prompt and/or a start image with one of StockCake's video models (list_models). Priced per second of output; needs a plan. Video usually takes longer than 45 s: expect a pending result and poll get_job. Requires a free StockCake account (the host will prompt to sign in)

tools.name: download_image
tools.description: Full-resolution download link for a StockCake image (CC0) or one of your edited images. Unmetered — no credits. format "png" returns the lossless sibling when one exists (falls back to jpg). Requires a free StockCake account (the host will prompt to sign in).

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status and result of a generate_image / upscale_image / resize_image / create_video job you started (pending, completed with URLs, or error with refund state). Requires a free StockCake account (the host will prompt to sign in).

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback about this server to its developers. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_images" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: query, orientation, type, color, mood, style, page, limit, locale, context, llm_model, conversation_id

evidence.snippet: id, include_preview, locale, context, llm_model, conversation_id

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_job" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job · Private data: send_feedback · Public sink: send_feedback · Destructive: resize_image, download_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job · Private data: send_feedback · Public sink: send_feedback · Destructive: resize_image, download_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
